children.name: Dicraspidia donnell-smithii Standl.
children.description: The sole species of the monotypic genus Dicraspidia (family Muntingiaceae, order Malvales), described by Standley in 1929. A shrub or small tree ~3-10 m tall with branches bearing a whitish indumentum of simple pilose hairs over dense stellate-velutinous trichomes, its native range extends from Mexico (Oaxaca) through Central America to Colombia in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Neotessmannia uniflora Burret
children.description: The only species of the monotypic genus Neotessmannia (family Muntingiaceae, order Malvales), described by Burret in 1924. It is a tree reported to about 8 m, native to Peru, growing primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
